quote.text: Afasta-te da companhia dos perniciosos, eles fazem nascer em ti um licenciosidade que lhe é natutal.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that the company we keep influences not only us but also our children; shield them from harmful influences to nurture their virtuous character.
    • Instill the value of thoughtful companionship by leading through example—choose interactions that encourage discipline and moral integrity for the sake of their growth.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, be discerning about those you surround yourself with, for a leader’s circle sets the tone for the norms of the whole organization.
    • Encourage a culture of accountability and virtue by distancing yourself from negativity, ensuring that the team cultivates a shared purpose rooted in good principles.
  • Product Management
    • Just as personal habits are shaped by influence, the quality of a product is deeply affected by the team’s mindset; avoid the pitfalls of negative attitudes to foster innovation.
    • Focus on building a cohesive and disciplined team where every member contributes to a purposeful and ethical vision, steering away from complacency or harmful shortcuts.
